Segnala offerta di lavoro Company Overview Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) software. Position Overview At Siemens, we are pioneering the next era of industrial digital transformation through the Prescriptive Selling Platform (PSP)—a purpose-built ecosystem designed to unify and optimize our global sales operations. As the Software Engineering Associate Manager , you will help team manager lead a highly collaborative, agile team, acting as a key bridge between Product Management and Software Operations to orchestrate seamless software delivery. You and your team will play a pivotal role in evolving PSP into an AI-ready platform—developing innovative AI use cases, transitioning to a modern client UI, and deepening integration with enterprise-grade platforms like Salesforce (SFDC) and Polarion. Are you a collaborative leader who thrives when guiding talented developers through major technological transformations? This role connects technical leadership with soem of initial people management responsibilities. Lead and develop engineering talent by supervising, hiring, training, and mentoring staff; take ownership of performance management and team growth Provide technical mentorship to junior engineers, offering hands-on guidance, problem resolution, and architectural leadership Design and architect robust software systems, including spearheading the re-architecting of critical internal systems to improve performance and scalability Ensure functional quality across all released software, driving high-quality, on-time delivery that consistently exceeds customer expectations Shape the technical roadmap for your product area, actively promoting innovation by introducing new technologies and advancing team capabilities Perform complex software engineering, working independently on advanced projects requiring deep technical judgment and architectural thinking Qualifications University degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, or related field (or equivalent professional experience) Experience in software engineering and application development within complex, enterprise-level software ecosystems or large-scale industrial digital transformation environments Proven experience collaborating closely with Product Management and Software Operations teams to deliver production-grade systems Experience in supervisory and leadership roles (e.g. team leader deputy) Deep technical proficiency in .NET Core (C#) for robust back-end services and React for modern, responsive front-ends; solid understanding of state management and asynchronous programming Practical experience evolving legacy platforms into AI-ready systems, including LLM integration via APIs and AI-driven features within modern UI/UX frameworks Hands-on expertise architecting and managing complex integrations with Salesforce (SFDC) and Polarion; strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, microservices architecture, and secure data exchange protocols Exceptional skill in creating and documenting software designs using Design Patterns, Clean Architecture, or Domain-Driven Design principles; ability to lead re-architecting efforts Fluent in Italian and English; minimal to light travel ( Nice to Have Experience with agile methodologies and scaling teams in fast-paced environments Familiarity with enterprise security protocols and compliance frameworks Background in industrial software or manufacturing technology domains Why Us We are Siemens: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow! Our Commitment to Equity and Inclusion We value your unique identity and perspective. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences. We welcome you to bring your authentic self and transform the everyday with us. In Accenture, potrai portare la tua visione innovativa per reinventare interi settori di mercato, lavorando con le aziende più importanti a livello mondiale. Modella il futuro del business e della tecnologia sviluppando soluzioni all'avanguardia in grado di generare nuovo valore. All'interno del Reinvention Partner Digital Core aiutiamo i clienti a reinventare la loro digital foundation, inclusa la strategia e l'architettura tecnologica, i dati e l'AI, la modernizzazione e la gestione delle applicazioni, l'infrastruttura, i dati e il cloud. Aiuta i clienti ad accelerare il loro percorso di reinvention con le soluzioni SAP Master Data Governance. In particolare potrai: Partecipare a progetti internazionali di implementazione e trasformazione digitale basati su SAP Master Data Governance (MDG), contribuendo alla definizione e all'ottimizzazione dei processi di gestione dei dati master aziendali Collaborare con team multidisciplinari per analizzare, disegnare e configurare soluzioni SAP MDG in linea con le esigenze del cliente e le best practice di settore Supportare l'integrazione di SAP MDG con altri moduli SAP (ECC, S/4HANA, BW) e sistemi esterni, garantendo coerenza e qualità del dato lungo l'intera catena del valore Sviluppare competenze avanzate su SAP S/4HANA e data governance, partecipando a programmi di formazione continua e percorsi di certificazione Entrare a far parte di un network globale di professionisti SAP, con prospettive di crescita verso ruoli di Solution Architect, Project Manager o Data Governance Lead. La retribuzione prevista in Accenture viene definita sulla base di molteplici elementi di valutazione, tra cui – ad esempio - il ruolo ricoperto, il livello di seniority, il grado di responsabilità, le competenze professionali e l’esperienza maturata. Per la presente posizione, è previsto un livello di inquadramento B1 nel CCNL Metalmeccanico (C011). La fascia di retribuzione annua lorda prevista è compresa tra 30.814,29€ e 45.300,00€. #LI-MP #LI-Hybrid Se condividi la nostra passione per le soluzioni SAP e hai le seguenti caratteristiche, ti stiamo aspettando: Dai 2 ai 4 anni di esperienza in progetti SAP MDG, con conoscenza dei processi di data governance e delle principali entità master (Business Partner, Material, Financial) Dai 2 ai 4 anni di esperienza nella configurazione dei moduli SAP MDG, Data Modeling, Rule-based Workflow e UI Modeling Esperienza con i principali strumenti di integrazione SAP (ALE, IDoc, Web Services) Esperienza in team internazionali e contesti di progetto complessi, con gestione di stakeholder tecnici e di business Conoscenza fluente della lingua inglese (scritta e parlata) Diploma di scuola superiore o Laurea (triennale o magistrale) in discipline STEM, economiche o affini Rappresenta un plus: Esperienza in progetti complessi a livello globale o multi-country Certificazioni SAP in ambito MDG o Data Management Conoscenza di data quality tools (SAP Data Services, Information Steward) o strumenti di data migration (LTMC, BODS) Interesse e passione verso strumenti di Intelligenza Artificiale About Accenture Accenture is a leading global professional services company that helps the world’s leading businesses, governments and other organizations build their digital core, optimize their operations, accelerate revenue growth and enhance citizen services—creating tangible value at speed and scale. We are a talent- and innovation-led company with approximately 791,000 people serving clients in more than 120 countries. Technology is at the core of change today, and we are one of the world’s leaders in helping drive that change, with strong ecosystem relationships. We combine our strength in technology and leadership in cloud, data and AI with unmatched industry experience, functional expertise and global delivery capability. Segnala offerta di lavoro About WPP Media WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working. For more information, visit wppmedia.com. Role Summary And Impact We are seeking a commercially minded and strategic Manager, Engagement Media Solutions, Italy to join the Engagement team within Media Solutions at WPP Media Italy. The role owns assigned client relationships and the development of programmatic and media solution opportunities, from promoting relevant offerings and prioritising opportunities to shaping strategy and proposals in response to client briefs. Skills And Experience Own relationships with assigned agency and client stakeholders, promote Media Solutions offerings, and identify and prioritise commercially relevant growth opportunities. Translate client briefs and business objectives into effective media solution strategies, recommendations and proposals. Lead the development of responses to client briefs and validate the strategic and operational proposal with the Activation team. Maintain strategic oversight during delivery and provide guidance when consulted by Activation on client strategy, priorities or solution positioning. Support Activation in resolving escalations and addressing complex budget, KPI and performance discussions within the assigned scope. Lead post-campaign analysis, transforming results, insights and learnings into actionable recommendations and new client opportunities. Present solutions, proposals, business cases and results to clients and internal stakeholders through clear, persuasive and data-informed storytelling. Partner with technology providers, media partners, sales, product and data teams to develop innovative solutions, effective ways of working and relevant best practices. Monitor programmatic technologies, formats and market developments, acting as a trusted point of reference for clients and internal teams. Build strong, long-term relationships with clients, agencies, partners and cross-functional stakeholders, coordinating contributors and ensuring effective delivery. Minimum 5 years of experience in media, programmatic or digital advertising, including relevant client-facing, consultancy, account-management or business-development responsibilities. Solid understanding of the programmatic ecosystem and wider digital media landscape. Ability to translate client briefs into strategic, effective and commercially relevant media solutions and proposals. Excellent communication, presentation and storytelling skills in Italian and English. Proficient in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Commercially minded, with a strong ability to recognise, assess and develop new opportunities. Collaborative and solutions-oriented, with the ability to work effectively across dynamic, cross-functional environments. Highly organised and analytical, with a proactive and adaptable mindset and the ability to manage multiple priorities Life At WPP Media & Benefits Our passion for shaping the next era of media is powered by our commitment to Be Extraordinary, investing in our employees to inspire transformational creativity. We also Lead Optimistically, firmly believing in and Championing Growth and Development for every individual. This commitment allows WPP Media employees to leverage the extensive global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, build vital professional connections, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We Create an Open environment built on trust and respect, where everyone feels they belong and has opportunities to progress. This inclusive culture is fostered through a variety of employee resource groups and frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our comprehensive benefits package reflects this commitment, including competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days. Segnala offerta di lavoro Deda Speed ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Deda Speed. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Rivolgiti al tuo recruiter per saperne di più. Livello retribuzione di base 28.000,00 €/yr - 32.000,00 €/anno Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Deda Speed Giovanna Intoccia Giovanna Intoccia Siamo alla ricerca di un/una Creative Lead con esperienza, visione strategica e sensibilità creativa, capace di guidare lo sviluppo e l'esecuzione delle attività creative. La persona entrerà a far parte del team con un ruolo trasversale, contribuendo a definire la direzione creativa dei diversi brand e assicurando coerenza, qualità e riconoscibilità su tutti i touchpoint: dai canali social alle piattaforme D2C, dalle campagne di comunicazione alle sponsorship, fino ai lanci di prodotto. Cerchiamo una figura capace di trasformare obiettivi di business e marketing in concept creativi distintivi, guidando il team nella loro realizzazione e garantendo un elevato standard qualitativo in ogni fase del processo E' previsto inserimento con Contratto in Partiva IVA. Cosa farai: Guiderai la direzione creativa dei progetti e delle attività di comunicazione dei brand, sviluppando concept e linee creative coerenti con il posizionamento e gli obiettivi di ciascun brand. Definirai e supervisionerai i concept creativi , traducendo brief e insight in idee rilevanti, originali e capaci di generare engagement. Presidierai la qualità creativa di tutti i materiali e contenuti prodotti, assicurando coerenza visiva, narrativa e stilistica su tutti i canali. Coordinerai e supporterai il team creativo nelle diverse fasi di sviluppo dei progetti, fornendo brief chiari, direzione, feedback e indicazioni operative. Gestirai le produzioni multi-canale , supervisionando lo sviluppo dei contenuti e delle campagne, dalla fase ideativa fino alla delivery finale. Garantirai la coerenza dei tone of voice e dei linguaggi visivi dei tre brand, valorizzandone le rispettive identità. Lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team Marketing e Commerciale , interpretandone le esigenze e contribuendo allo sviluppo di soluzioni creative efficaci. Must Have: Almeno 5 anni di esperienza in agenzie creative, digital o di comunicazione, oppure in team creativi interni a realtà strutturate. Una comprovata esperienza in art direction e sviluppo di concept creativi , dalla fase di ideazione alla realizzazione. Ottime capacità di copywriting e storytelling , con sensibilità nella costruzione di messaggi e narrazioni di brand. Esperienza nella gestione e supervisione di progetti e produzioni multi-canale (social, digital, campagne, contenuti, attivazioni e materiali di comunicazione). Capacità di sviluppare brief, guidare il lavoro creativo e fornire feedback costruttivi al team. Una buona comprensione delle dinamiche di brand communication e dei diversi linguaggi richiesti dai canali digitali e tradizionali. Le caratteristiche che fanno la differenza: Visione creativa e attenzione al dettaglio. Autonomia, proattività e capacità di prendere decisioni. Ottime capacità relazionali e attitudine al lavoro in team multidisciplinari. Capacità di gestire priorità, scadenze e progetti diversi in parallelo. Flessibilità e capacità di adattare approccio e linguaggio alle identità di brand differenti. Orientamento al risultato, senza perdere di vista la qualità e la distintività delle idee. Le soft skills che riteniamo importanti Siamo alla ricerca di una persona con propensione al problem-solving, proattiva, propensa a trasmettere la propria esperienza alle figure più junior, oltre che flessibile e motivata. Dedicated to Growth Che si tratti di un software, di una soluzione tecnologica o di una consulenza, al cuore di ogni progetto ci sono sempre persone che lavorano insieme ad altre persone. Competenti e curiose, ambiziose e tenaci: alle Deda People piace imparare, confrontarsi, migliorare. La dedizione, per noi, è attitudine al miglioramento continuo, ricerca di obiettivi sempre nuovi, raggiungimento di risultati e capacità di lavorare insieme. ll nostro impegno è far crescere le persone perché possano migliorare, esprimere al meglio il proprio potenziale e contribuire alla costruzione di un futuro migliore: per sé, per Deda e per la società tutta. I nostri annunci sono rivolti alle candidate e ai candidati di qualsiasi espressione di genere, orientamento sessuale, età, etnia e credo religioso (ai sensi dei D.Lgs. 198/2006, D.Lgs. 215/2003, D.Lgs. 216/2003). I dati acquisiti con la ricezione dei curriculum vitae sono trattati da Dedagroup S.p.A. al fine di valutare il possibile interesse alla futura costituzione di un rapporto contrattuale. Tali informazioni potranno essere trasmesse alle varie società appartenenti al Gruppo Dedagroup secondo quanto previsto nell’Informativa Privacy. La figura avrà la responsabilità di definire e implementare le strategie di sviluppo del business, consolidare il posizionamento sul mercato e supportare l'evoluzione organizzativa dell'azienda in un contesto caratterizzato da innovazione tecnologica e forte potenziale di espansione. Principali responsabilità Definire e guidare la strategia commerciale e di sviluppo aziendale, con particolare attenzione alla crescita del fatturato e all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti. Rafforzare la presenza dell'azienda sul mercato attraverso iniziative di business development, marketing e networking. Sviluppare e consolidare relazioni con clienti strategici, partner e stakeholder di riferimento. Supportare l'espansione in nuovi mercati e l'apertura di nuove opportunità commerciali, anche a livello internazionale. Affiancare il team commerciale nella gestione delle trattative più complesse e delle opportunità a maggiore valore aggiunto. Promuovere una cultura aziendale orientata al cliente, ai risultati e al miglioramento continuo. Collaborare con le funzioni tecniche e operative per favorire una maggiore valorizzazione dell'offerta e del portafoglio prodotti. Monitorare i principali indicatori economici e di performance, garantendo un approccio imprenditoriale e orientato alla creazione di valore. Guidare e sviluppare il management team, favorendo collaborazione, responsabilizzazione e crescita professionale delle persone. Requisiti Laurea in discipline economiche, ingegneristiche o affini. Almeno 8-10 anni di esperienza in ruoli manageriali presso aziende IT tecnologiche o caratterizzate da un forte contenuto di innovazione. Solida esperienza nello sviluppo commerciale, nel business development e nella gestione delle relazioni con clienti strategici. Capacità di operare trasversalmente tra funzioni commerciali, prodotto e operations. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di team e organizzazioni strutturate. Familiarità con modelli di business basati su software, servizi ricorrenti, digitalizzazione e innovazione tecnologica. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Caratteristiche personali Forte orientamento al mercato e alle opportunità di business development. Mentalità imprenditoriale e commerciale, approccio pragmatico e orientamento ai risultati. Spiccate capacità relazionali e di leadership. Elevata sensibilità economica e capacità di individuare opportunità di crescita profittevole. Attitudine a creare consenso, motivare i team e guidare il cambiamento. Forte presenza sul territorio e disponibilità a incontrare regolarmente clienti e prospect. Cosa offre il ruolo L'opportunità di assumere un ruolo strategico all'interno di una realtà solida ed in crescita, contribuendo direttamente alle decisioni di sviluppo aziendale, all'ampliamento del mercato e alla definizione delle future linee di business. Siamo un'azienda italiana di gioielleria Made in Italy. Nel 2027 avviamo un piano di crescita che riguarda prodotto, brand e distribuzione, con un forte focus sull'estero. Cerchiamo la persona che costruirà da zero il nostro mercato internazionale, riportando al Direttore Generale e all'Amministratore Delegato. Cosa farai Analizzerai i mercati esteri e, partendo dalle ipotesi già formulate dall'azienda, confermerai o rivedrai la scelta dei 2-3 Paesi prioritari, valutando potenziale, concorrenza, posizionamento di prezzo e barriere d'ingresso. Definirai il piano commerciale estero: canali, modello distributivo (distributori, agenti, retailer multimarca, department store, e-commerce/marketplace), politiche di prezzo e condizioni commerciali. Gestirai il budget export e definirai gli obiettivi di fatturato, margine e numero di nuovi clienti. Cercherai, selezionerai e attiverai distributori, agenti e punti vendita qualificati, negoziando i contratti e seguendo direttamente i clienti chiave. Gestirai le fiere internazionali e gli incontri con i buyer. Riporterai a prodotto e marketing le indicazioni dei mercati su collezioni, fasce di prezzo e materiali di comunicazione e vendita. Collaborerai con amministrazione e credito per valutare l'affidabilità dei clienti e definire termini di pagamento sicuri, e ti coordinerai con logistica e amministrazione su spedizioni, dogane e documentazione export. Misurerai l'andamento per mercato e per cliente con un reporting periodico (sell-in, sell-out, incassi, margini) e proporrai correzioni alla strategia in base ai risultati. Obiettivi Entro 2 mesi presenterai il piano export alla direzione. Entro 12 mesi dovrai attivare i primi distributori o agenti, partecipare ad almeno 2 fiere internazionali e ottenere i primi ordini ricorrenti. Entro 24 mesi l'obiettivo è una rete distributiva stabile in 2-3 Paesi e un fatturato estero pari al 10% del totale, con margini e incassi in linea con il budget. Requisiti Almeno 5 anni nell'export in gioielleria, orologeria o accessori di lusso e fashion. Esperienza comprovata nell'apertura di nuovi mercati e nella costruzione di reti di distributori e agenti. Inglese fluente; una seconda lingua (tedesco, spagnolo, francese o arabo) è un forte plus. Conoscenza dei contratti di distribuzione e agenzia, degli Incoterms e della documentazione export. Gestione di budget, prezzi e marginalità. Costituiscono un plus l'esperienza in aziende in crescita o nel lancio di un brand poco conosciuto, la conoscenza del mercato UK e Irlanda con contatti attivi nel trade, la familiarità con e-commerce e marketplace e una laurea in ambito economico. Profilo personale Imprenditorialità: capacità di lavorare in autonomia e costruire un'area da zero, senza una struttura già pronta. Orientamento ai risultati, con l'abitudine a misurare il proprio lavoro in fatturato, margini e incassi. Sensibilità di prodotto e di brand, con la capacità di raccontare il valore del Made in Italy. Prudenza commerciale: capacità di bilanciare la crescita con la gestione del rischio sui crediti. Cosa offriamo Un ruolo chiave in una fase di forte crescita, con autonomia e un rapporto diretto con la direzione. Contratto a tempo indeterminato, CCNL Terziario Confcommercio, livello Quadro o 1° livello in base all'esperienza. RAL tra 45.000 e 50.000 €, più un variabile del 30% della RAL al raggiungimento degli obiettivi (fino al 45% in caso di superamento), legato agli incassi esteri. Sede a Milano, con trasferte all'estero per circa il 40-50% del tempo. Telefono, PC e rimborso delle spese di trasferta. La ricerca è rivolta a candidati di entrambi i sessi (D.Lgs. 198/2006). I dati saranno trattati ai sensi del GDPR (Reg. UE 2016/679). Segnala offerta di lavoro At Nouryon, our global team takes positive action every day, to reach higher collectively and individually. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future. We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you? About the job As Business Development Manager Textile EMEA, you will be a sales-driven commercial leader, accountable for the profitable growth of our textile business across the Surfactants, CMC and Chelates product lines. You will own the sales number for your territory and deliver it through key customers and, above all, through a strong network of distributors: selecting, developing, motivating and steering distribution partners to win market share, widen our customer base and protect margin. You will combine a hunter’s drive for new business with disciplined account and distributor management, working closely with Technical Service, R&D and Marketing across the EMEA region. In addition, you will be responsible for managing the Expancel business in Italy, including the distributor. A proven sales background in chemicals for textile – surfactants, wetting agents, antifoams and thickeners – is a must for this role. In your future role as Business Development Manager Textile you will •    Own and deliver sales, revenue and margin targets for the Textile segment in your territory, with full accountability for budget, forecast and results. •    Lead distribution management: select, onboard, develop and steer distributors; agree annual business plans, sales targets, terms and incentives; and review their performance (sell-in, sell-out, stock, margin) on a regular basis. •    Grow sales through distributors: run joint customer visits, share and follow up leads, review pipelines together and ensure coverage of mills, dyehouses, finishers and formulators; identify white spaces and appoint or replace distributors where needed. •    Train and coach distributor sales and technical teams on products, applications and value propositions, enabling them to sell with confidence and win against competition. •    Manage and grow key accounts – mills, brands, formulators and converters – building long-term relationships at purchasing, technical and management levels. •    Hunt for new business: identify, qualify and convert new customers, applications and segments in textile processing, finishing and adjacent markets, and build a strong pipeline from lead to order. •    Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, contracts, rebates and supply agreements, safeguarding profitability and aligning with business strategy. •    Develop and execute account and distributor plans; coordinate customer trials with Technical Service and R&D to turn technical wins into repeat sales. •    Monitor market trends, competitor activity and pricing, translating insights into sales actions and strategic recommendations. •    Drive accurate sales forecasting, opportunity management and CRM discipline to support effective business planning. •    Manage the Expancel business in Italy, including the distributor. •    Collaborate with cross-functional teams and represent Nouryon at industry events, trade shows and customer meetings to expand our position in the textile market. We believe you bring •    Must have: proven sales background in chemicals for textile applications – specifically surfactants, wetting agents, antifoams and thickeners (e.g. alkoxylates, CMC and other polymers, chelating agents). This is a non-negotiable requirement. •    Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Textile Engineering, or related technical discipline. •    At least 5 to 8 years in B2B sales and/or business development in chemicals, ideally textile chemicals. •    Proven track record in distribution management: selecting, developing and steering distributors or sales agents and delivering sales growth and margin improvement through the channel. •    Proven track record in key account management, delivering sales growth and margin improvement. •    Demonstrated experience in developing new business, launching new products or opening new segments/regions. •    Strong technical understanding of chemical products and their use in textile processing and finishing; ability to translate technical features into customer value. •    Experience working in an international, matrix environment and collaborating with cross‑functional teams. •    Fluency in Italian and English; additional languages are an advantage. We believe you are •    A commercially driven sales professional with strong negotiation and closing skills, able to create customer value while delivering profitable growth. •    A proactive business developer with a hunter mentality who enjoys identifying new opportunities, opening doors and converting prospects into long-term business. •    A natural channel manager and relationship builder, able to motivate and steer distributors and build trust with customers and stakeholders at all levels. •    Technically curious and able to translate technical capabilities into customer value. •    Entrepreneurial and results-oriented, with the ability to manage opportunities and projects from idea to successful implementation. •    Analytical and data-driven, using sell-out, pipeline, market and margin data to steer distributors and customers and turn insights into actionable plans. •    Well-organized and self-motivated, with strong planning and prioritization skills and the ability to balance short-term results with long-term growth initiatives. •    An effective communicator and presenter who can engage both technical and commercial audiences with confidence. •    A collaborative team player who thrives in an international environment and combines a high level of ownership, accountability and drive with strong cross-functional cooperation. We offer you •    A competitive gross annual salary ranging from €70.800 to € 100.000 based on your experience, skills and qualifications. •    An attractive bonus scheme. •    Training opportunities. •    Personal development and career planning. •    An international, fascinating and ambitious environment with highly skilled and motivated colleagues. Have we got your interest? This is a permanent position on a full-time basis, reporting to Nicolò Marelli, Regional Sales Director EMEIA, and is based in Italy, Milan. Please apply via our online recruitment system. We will not accept applications via e-mail. Once it's with us we will review to see if we have a match between your skills and the role! For more information about our hiring process, visit: nouryon.com/careers/how-we-hire/ We look forward to receiving your application! We kindly ask our internal candidates to apply with your Nouryon email via Success Factors. Explore careers and life at Nouryon If you’re looking for your next career move, apply today and join Nouryon’s worldwide team in providing essential solutions that our customers use to manufacture everyday products such as personal care, cleaning, paints and coatings, agriculture and food, pharmaceuticals, and building products. Our employees are driven by the wish to make an impact and actively drive positive change. If that describes you, we will gladly make way for your ambitions. From day one we support you with your personal growth, through challenging positions and comprehensive learning and development opportunities, in a dynamic, international, diverse, and proactive working environment. Visit our website and follow us on LinkedIn. Contact For additional information about the vacancy please contact Diana Martinez, Talent Acquisition Partner, diana.martinez@nouryon.com #WeAreNouryon #GrowWithUs We have already chosen our sourcing channels for this recruitment and kindly ask not to be contacted by any advertisement agents, recruitment agencies or staffing companies. Area Sales Manager – Italy We are seeking great talent to help us build The DNA of tech.® Vishay manufactures one of the world's largest portfolios of discrete semiconductors and passive electronic components that are essential to innovative designs in the automotive, industrial, computing, consumer, telecommunications, military, aerospace, and medical markets. We help the world's most in-demand technologies come to life. Every day our products touch your life and the lives of people across the world, though you likely do not know it. Come join us and help us build The DNA of tech.™ Vishay Intertechnology, Inc. is a Fortune 1,000 Company listed on the NYSE (VSH). Learn more at www.Vishay.com. Do you want to help us build the DNA of tech.? Vishay is currently seeking applicants for an Area Sales Manager – Italy (ideally located in our Milano Sales Office). In this position, you will drive profitable growth across a specific Area in Italy by developing customer relationships, building and managing a healthy pipeline, and ensuring strong cross-functional coordination to deliver value and execution excellence for customers. What You Will Be Doing Own territory execution across an Area in Italy, including account planning, customer coverage (direct, POS customers & distribution network), pipeline management, and forecasting accuracy. Develop and maintain strong relationships (with our direct, POS customers & distribution network) with customer stakeholderders (purchasing, engineering, program management, quality, leadership). Identify and structure new business and demand creation opportunities; support design activity and conversion into revenue. Drive commercial discussions with our direct or POS customers (working via our distribution network) and ensure disciplined follow-up and execution. Provide market & customer intelligence (applications, trends, competitors) and translate it into focused actions. Coordinate cross-functional resources and if needed align with the Sales Team (Distribution Sales, Key Accounts, Business Development, Customer Experience, Inside Sales) and relevant internal partners (Marketing, Quality, Logistic, Legal…) to deliver on customer needs. Plan and coordinate activities within assigned local projects/workstreams, together with involved management and stakeholders. Track milestones, evaluate progress, and support final acceptance of deliverables where applicable. What You Will Bring Along Proven B2B sales / account management experience, ideally in electronic components, semiconductors, or a comparable technical/industrial environment. Strong commercial mindset, negotiation skills, and ability to manage multiple stakeholders. Structured, proactive, customer-oriented approach; hands-on mentality and high accountability. Strong communication skills in English; Italian fluency is expected. Willingness to travel mainly within Italy. Good knowledge of CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and standard business software (MS Office). What Can We Offer You For Your Talent Vishay offers a comprehensive suite of benefit programs including health care coverage, financial support programs and other resources designed to help you achieve your personal and professional goals. With us, you'll experience unique career paths, an open and collaborative culture, a stable business that will be there for you, and opportunities to work globally and locally. Do you have the skills we need? Are you ready to power your career as you power the world? If so, apply today. Vishay committed to a workplace free of harassment and unlawful discrimination. We do not engage in discrimination or harassment based on race, color, age, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, ethnicity or national origin, disability, pregnancy, religion, political affiliation, union membership, covered veteran status, protected genetic information or marital status in hiring and employment practices. At ABB , we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world. This position reports to: Chapter Lead __ Your Role And Responsibilities In this role, you will define the global solution strategy and support the commercialization of integrated solutions for emerging Direct Current (DC) applications, leveraging ABB's breakthrough Solid-State Circuit Breaker (SSCB) technology. You will act as the strategic bridge between customer system-level requirements and platform engineering, architecting complete solution offerings for target applications such as DC Data Centers, Marine/industrial DC distribution, DC microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) and EV charging infrastructure. The work model for the role is Hybrid:  (partially onsite and partially remote). This role has a global scope and belongs to the Electrification business area, Smart Power division, within the Agile organization. Key stakeholders include Sales & Segment teams, Platform teams, R&D, System Engineering, Marketing and external ecosystem partners (OEMs, EPCs, system integrators). You will report to the Solution Product Management Infrastructure Chapter Lead. Our team dynamics You will join a multidisciplinary, entrepreneurial Agile team focused on advanced electrification technology. Our culture fosters autonomy, collaboration, and rapid experimentation, giving you the space to drive pioneering DC solutions that accelerate industrial decarbonization. You will be mainly accountable for: Conduct comprehensive market intelligence and segment analysis across emerging DC applications (e.g., hyperscale data centers, BESS, DC microgrids, marine DC distribution) to evaluate market potential, regulatory standards, competitor offerings, and customer adoption barriers. Formulate and execute the global solution roadmap, translating SSCB platform capabilities and complementary hardware/software into modular, repeatable, and scalable solution architectures and reference designs. Define clear customer value propositions, total cost of ownership (TCO) models, and value-based pricing strategies that demonstrate the clear operational, efficiency, and safety benefits of DC systems and solid-state protection over traditional mechanical solutions. Partner closely with Platform teams to convey system-level customer requirements, define integration interfaces (digital protocols, supervisory control, thermal and mechanical integration), and co-steer development roadmaps. Manage global go-to-market and commercialization strategies for DC/SSCB solutions in close cooperation with Division Marketing, Key Account Managers, and Local Sales Units, establishing pilot customer sites, application guidelines, and reference cases. Build and develop strategic partnerships across the emerging DC ecosystem, including energy storage integrators, power electronics manufacturers, standardization bodies, and switchgear builders. Manage the complete solution lifecycle, define performance KPIs, track revenue and margins, monitor quality and field performance, and steer portfolio evolution. Equip front-end sales teams, technical promoters, and partners with tailored application training, solution selectors, architecture blueprints, and commercial collateral. Qualifications For The Role Master's or Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Energy Systems, or Management Engineering. 5 to 7+ years of experience in product or solution management, technical marketing, or systems engineering within low-voltage/medium-voltage electrical distribution, power electronics, or energy transition domains. Solid technical grasp of Direct Current (DC) power architectures, protection schemes, power conversion, and semiconductor-based switching (SSCB) principles. Experience in application-oriented solution development, customer journey analysis, and building business cases based on Total Cost of Ownership (TCO). Familiarity with target DC applications such as Datacenters, Battery Energy Storage (BESS), DC microgrids, high-power DC fast-charging hubs, or DC distribution in marine. Solid cross-functional leadership, business acumen, stakeholder management, and communication skills within multinational, matrix organizations. Experience working in Agile frameworks and cross-functional chapter/squad structures. Fluency in English (written and verbal); additional languages. Willingness to travel up to 20-30% What's in it for you? Opportunity to help shape global markets, bring new ideas to life, and develop your strategic business acumen in a multinational environment. We empower you to take initiative, bring new ideas, and lead with confidence. You'll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that's tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. This role is primarily based in Bergamo, Italy or in Heidelberg, Germany. We will consider applications from candidates in neighboring countries who demonstrate solid qualifications and alignment with our requirements. More About Us Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and low-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification This opportunity is open to candidates in one or more countries covered by the European Pay Transparency Directive. Per il potenziamento della propria struttura commerciale, il Gruppo Dylog / Buffetti è alla ricerca di un/una Channel Manager che provenga dal mercato dei software gestionali e dalla gestione dei Partner. La figura sarà il punto di riferimento per il territorio assegnato e avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare il business attraverso la gestione, valorizzazione e crescita della rete dei Partner commerciali Dylog e Buffetti, garantendo il raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali e il consolidamento della presenza sul mercato. Riporterà al Responsabile Commerciale del Canale Indiretto. Principali responsabilità • Gestire, supportare e sviluppare il network dei Partner commerciali presenti sul territorio assegnato. • Costruire relazioni solide e durature con i Partner, diventandone il principale punto di riferimento operativo e commerciale. • Definire e implementare piani di sviluppo business condivisi con i Partner. • Monitorare il raggiungimento degli obiettivi commerciali, analizzando KPI, performance e opportunità di crescita. • Supportare i Partner nelle attività di vendita, affiancandoli nelle trattative strategiche e nelle iniziative commerciali più rilevanti. • Garantire la crescita dei ricavi ricorrenti attraverso il presidio dei rinnovi contrattuali e delle attività di upselling e cross-selling. • Individuare nuove opportunità di business nel territorio di competenza. • Ricercare, selezionare e sviluppare nuovi Partner commerciali coerenti con la strategia aziendale. • Coordinare attività di formazione, engagement e sviluppo delle competenze della rete Partner. • Raccogliere informazioni di mercato, analizzare i trend competitivi e proporre azioni di miglioramento e sviluppo. • Partecipare ad eventi, meeting e iniziative dedicate alla rete commerciale. Its portfolio includes beloved IP characters such as THE MONSTERS , TWINKLE TWINKLE, CRYBABY, DIMOO, SKULLPANDA, Hirono and MOLLY. As of the first half of 2026, POP MART had more than 100 million registered members worldwide, operated 676 physical stores and over 2,800 ROBO SHOP vending machines, and reached nearly 100 countries and regions through cross-border e-commerce platforms,bringing joy to consumers around the world. POP MART has established a strong presence across key European markets, including Spain, Italy, Netherlands, France, and the UK. Ensure compliance with company SOPs, operational policies, safety standards and local retail regulations Cross-functional Collaboration Work closely with internal teams such as Marketing, HR and Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Aira Elena Cutrupi Elena Cutrupi As Senior Paid Media Specialist, you’ll run the paid acquisition engine behind Aira’s growth across our European markets. Working day to day with our paid media agencies, you’ll plan, build and optimize campaigns across Search, Social, Display and Native, and drive results against CPL, CAC and lead quality. This is a hands-on global role in the Global Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing and based in Lainate (Milano). About Aira 10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating, and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slash energy costs, one home at a time . Founded in 2022, and with 1,000+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions, including heat pumps, solar power and battery storage . With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland , headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden , and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy , Aira is on track to bring clean energy-tech to every home. Find out more about us on our website . The role We’re looking for a Senior Paid Media Specialist based in Lainate (Milano) to help us scale customer acquisition across Aira’s markets. You’ll report to the global Head of Growth Marketing and have global scope . This is a hands-on role at the centre of our lead acquisition engine . You’ll work with our paid media agencies to build, run and optimize campaigns, keep our ad accounts healthy on every platform we use, and help us test and scale new ones. You’ll also support landing pages and creative, working with our creative agency to turn insights into better-converting experiences. Your work will have a direct impact on the growth of our customer base and revenue, and will be fundamental to Aira’s ambition of becoming the leader in clean energy solutions. What You'll Do Run our acquisition with our agencies. Work day to day with our paid media agencies to plan, build, launch and optimize campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display and Native. Review performance, challenge assumptions and make sure campaigns are built and run to the highest standard. Manage budgets and drive results against CPL, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and lead quality. Support performance of our affiliate partners. Keep our platforms healthy. Own the health of our ad accounts on every platform we run. Audit account structure, conversion tracking, bidding and audience setup, follow up on platform recommendations and health reports, and make sure the signals we send support profitable growth. Test and scale new channels. Explore, test and scale new platforms and channels, building the test plan, defining success criteria and making clear scale or stop decisions. Improve landing pages and creative. Build, test and optimize landing pages in our CMS to improve conversion. Work with our creative agency on briefs, ad concepts and creative testing, and bring performance insights back into the creative process. Turn data into decisions. Use HubSpot, Excel and AI tools to create and maintain reports and dashboards, automate recurring analysis and surface insights faster. Track key performance metrics and support budgeting and forecasting. What You'll Bring To The Role 2-4 years of experience in an agency or in an ad operations role, with hands-on campaign building. Strong experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads and Native Ads, including campaign setup, optimization and account audits. Solid knowledge of conversion tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager or similar). Strong analytical skills and experience turning campaign data into clear recommendations, with comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis and reporting. Experience building or optimizing landing pages and working with creative teams or agencies. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Excellent written and spoken both Italian and English, as you’ll work with colleagues and partners across several markets. Preferred experience in: building AI agents; Microsoft Ads, TikTok or LinkedIn; HubSpot and a headless CMS such as Strapi What's In For You Salary range: €36,000 - €40,000 gross per year; permanent contract. Hybrid working policy and a yearly welfare budget. Collaboration with a diverse, international team and the opportunity to see your work come to life across multiple channels and European markets. The chance to shape how a growing clean energy brand reaches homeowners, making an important and complex topic more accessible, engaging and relevant. The opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing scale-up with a dynamic, solution-oriented culture. Our hiring process : intro call - interview with the Head of Growth Marketing - interview with another member of the Global marketing team - final interview with the Global marketing director. The role is based in Lainate office, near Milano. This could be you if You’ve built a spreadsheet, a dashboard or a process nobody asked for, because the old way didn’t make sense. When a number looks wrong, you can’t let it go until you understand why. You naturally end up working across teams, connecting what marketing, sales and partners each see on their own. You’re curious about how the whole funnel works, not just your piece of it. You’re ready for more responsibility and looking for a place that will give it to you. Don’t tick every box? Apply anyway, and tell us about one thing you built, fixed or figured out that you’re proud of. At Aira, we champion next-generation energy as well as diversity and inclusion. We firmly believe that a diverse workforce fosters innovation and creativity, helping us better serve our customers and communities. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, cultures and perspectives to join us in building a cleaner, more sustainable future. La ricerca è rivolta ad entrambi i sessi (L. 903/77). Posizione Cerchiamo una figura di Digital Communication & Social Media Specialist che contribuisca allo sviluppo, alla gestione e all'ottimizzazione della comunicazione digitale e dei canali social di Lombardini22. La risorsa lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Direttore Marketing, Comunicazione ed Eventi, collaborando alla definizione e all'implementazione di piani di comunicazione integrati, coerenti con gli obiettivi di business, il posizionamento e le diverse audience del Gruppo. Cerchiamo una figura con una buona visione strategica e solide capacità operative, in grado di tradurre brief, obiettivi e priorità aziendali in attività concrete, coordinando contenuti, canali, campagne e interlocutori interni. Attività richieste La risorsa si occuperà, nello specifico, delle seguenti attività: Contribuire alla definizione e allo sviluppo di strategie di comunicazione digitale a partire da brief, eventi, temi editoriali e obiettivi di business; Sviluppare e gestire piani social e digitali per campagne corporate, employer branding, thought leadership ed eventi; Gestire il piano editoriale e i canali social, con particolare focus su LinkedIn e Instagram; Ideare e realizzare copy social, caption, headline e CTA coerenti con i diversi target e il posizionamento aziendale; Coordinare la produzione dei contenuti in collaborazione con i team interni e i diversi professionisti coinvolti; Gestire e monitorare campagne LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads e, ove necessario, Google Ads, occupandosi della loro ottimizzazione; Monitorare i KPI, analizzare le performance dei canali e delle campagne e predisporre report periodici con insight e proposte di miglioramento; Collaborare con la Direzione, il team PR, Eventi, Grafica, Content Creator e gli altri stakeholder interni per garantire coerenza ed efficacia delle attività di comunicazione. Competenze richieste Capacità di interpretare obiettivi e brief e tradurli in piani e attività di comunicazione concreti; Ottime capacità di scrittura, sintesi e adattamento dei contenuti ai diversi canali e target; Buone capacità relazionali e di gestione degli interlocutori interni; Capacità di gestire priorità e scadenze. Conoscenze informatiche Ottima conoscenza dei principali strumenti informatici; Ottima conoscenza di LinkedIn e Instagram, preferibilmente in ambito corporate/B2B; Conoscenza operativa delle piattaforme LinkedIn Ads, Meta Ads e Google Ads; Familiarità con Sprout Social o strumenti analoghi di social media management, monitoraggio e reportistica; Conoscenza delle logiche di social SEO. Conoscenze linguistiche Ottima conoscenza della lingua italiana scritta e parlata; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese scritta e parlata. Formazione richiesta Laurea in Comunicazione, Marketing, Media, Digital o discipline affini. Esperienza richiesta Esperienza di 3-5 anni in comunicazione digitale, social media management, social strategy, content marketing, brand communication o digital marketing; Esperienza maturata preferibilmente in ambito B2B, presso agenzie di comunicazione, società di consulenza o realtà operanti nei settori media, real estate, design, tecnologia e servizi professionali; Esperienza nella gestione di piani editoriali, produzione di contenuti e campagne digitali, con il coinvolgimento di diversi stakeholder. Altre informazioni La ricerca è rivolta a professionisti di ambo i sessi. La sede di lavoro è presso la Società Lombardini22 S.p.A., Via Elia Lombardini 22, 20143 Milano. Descrizione della posizione La risorsa entrerà a far parte della practice SAP (Business Technology & Artificial Intelligence), riportando alla direzione della practice. Avrà un ruolo trasversale di technology enablement: portare l'AI generativa nei progetti, nei team e presso i clienti, su tutte le industry. Guidare e accelerare l'adozione della Generative AI nella practice, sul fronte della produttività interna e delle progettualità per i clienti; Promuovere SAP Business AI e la sua integrazione nei processi e negli ecosistemi applicativi dei clienti; Fare da architect di riferimento per le soluzioni su SAP BTP e le relative funzionalità AI; Supportare le aree commerciali e di solutioning in pre-vendita: proposte, fattibilità tecnologica e presentazione ai clienti; Affiancare i team di delivery nell'individuare use case, definire best practice e portare le soluzioni AI in produzione, Coordinare team di progetto in base alle esigenze, valorizzando le competenze di sviluppo già presenti; Presidiare enablement, formazione e condivisione delle competenze AI; Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offering SAP AI esistente, monitorando le novità dell'ecosistema SAP; Promuovere un approccio all'AI coerente con sicurezza, governance e Responsible AI. Requisiti Consolidata esperienza in società di consulenza tecnologica, system integrator o boutique specializzate nell'ecosistema SAP; Solido background tecnico SAP, con percorso da ABAP verso SAP BTP e ruoli di Solution o Technical Architect; Approfondita conoscenza di SAP BTP, di S/4HANA e dei principi di Clean Core, con approccio pratico e curiosità tecnica; Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni architetturali e nel supporto a pre-vendita e solutioning; Conoscenza delle tecnologie AI e Generative AI e delle loro applicazioni in contesti enterprise; Capacità di tradurre esigenze di business in use case concreti e scalabili; Leadership trasversale, credibilità e capacità di influenzare team e stakeholder anche senza riporti diretti; spiccate capacità comunicative; Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese; Preferibile: prime esperienze di adozione di soluzioni AI in progetti di trasformazione SAP, anche come proof of concept; Preferibile: familiarità con SAP Joule, AI Core, Generative AI Hub, AI agent e RAG; certificazioni SAP in ambito BTP o AI. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About The Opportunity Job Type: Permanent Application Deadline: 31 December 2026 Title Senior Marketing Manager Department EMEA Marketing Location Milan, Italy Reports To Head of Growth Marketing, Italy Level Senior Manager We help our clients invest for the future and to live the lives they want to lead. It’s a responsibility we take seriously and it inspires us to do the right thing. Not just for our clients, but for each other and the world around us too. About your team : Growth Marketing is the main business partner to Sales in the EMEA distribution business and trusted partners to the EMEA Marketing Specialist Centres of Excellence for Content, Channel Activation and Marketing Services. They are accountable for the performance of Marketing in country and are expected to have strong insight into the local market dynamics alongside broad understanding of the marketing channel mix and it’s suitability for client segments. As such, the team works closely with colleagues to understand commercial priorities, identify where Marketing can create the greatest value, allocate resources and apply the right specialist capabilities to each opportunity. About your role : As the Growth Marketing lead for the Fund Seller (Distribution) client segment in Italy, you will be accountable for translating the ambitious growth strategy for our Italian business into marketing strategy, owning the agenda for this segment from annual planning through to performance management. This means you will ensure the Fund Seller (Distribution) segment has a clear, prioritised plan aligned with Sales targets and pipeline goals. This includes owning the brief to - and orchestrating the interface with - Specialist Content, Channel Activation and Marketing Services teams, where each Specialist team is then accountable for the response and delivery within its remit. Your responsibilities will include: Own the Sales-Marketing alignment process: pipeline targets, campaign roadmaps, audience priorities Define the growth marketing strategy, priorities and budget allocation for the Italian market Develop client and market insights that can evolve the local strategy and fuel more impactful campaigns Ensure business priorities are translated into clear briefs for Specialist CoE teams Monitor marketing performance and reallocate effort dynamically based on results Your success will be demonstrated through: Revenue and net flows contribution attributable to marketing activity in market Quality and consistency of Sales-Marketing alignment, measured through pipeline coverage, campaign conversion and joint planning discipline Effective deployment of Marketing resources across markets: clear priorities, well-structured briefs, dynamic reallocation of effort Senior business stakeholders’ confidence in Marketing as a driver of commercial outcomes, not a support function About you : You are a commercially fluent marketer with good understanding of the Italian asset management industry. Through this experience, you bring the credibility to challenge Sales when needed and the discipline to align with them when it counts. You are able to connect strategy to efficient execution and hold yourself accountable for business outcomes. The ideal candidate will have: Experience of the Italian asset management industry, preferably supporting distribution of product to the Fund Seller segment Demonstrable understanding of commercial outcomes in the industry (AUM growth, pipeline growth, asset retention) Strong understanding of campaign management, audience segmentation and performance measurement Ability to build and sustain effective operating partnerships between Marketing, Sales and Distribution Partners Excellent communication skills; able to operate effectively senior business stakeholders Native level of Italian and business fluency in English required Feel rewarded : For starters, we’ll offer you a comprehensive benefits package. We’ll value your wellbeing and support your development. And we’ll be as flexible as we can about where and when you work – finding a balance that works for all of us. It’s all part of our commitment to making you feel motivated by the work you do and happy to be part of our team. For more about our work, our approach to dynamic working and how you could build your future here, visit careers.fidelityinternational.com. Segnala offerta di lavoro Short title Win and grow client relationships Introduction You thrive where strong client relationships, commercial thinking, and great social work come together. As Senior Client Service Manager in Italy, you lead a portfolio of client relationships, pitch ideas that win, and keep every project profitable and on track. You know your social media KPIs inside out and turn them into real growth for your clients and for Pulse. You join a hands-on team in Milan, backed by 100+ Pulse people around the world. If that sounds like your next step, apply now. Your tasks You lead and strategically develop a portfolio of client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and growing each account over the long term. You independently create compelling pitches and proposals, present them to clients with confidence, and help shape new sales approaches. You own the commercial health of your portfolio, steering fees, margins, and budgets so every account stays profitable and sustainable. You manage projects end to end, aligning the internal team on quality, timelines, and deliverables while continuously improving our workflows. You analyse performance results and social media KPIs, build reports and project evaluations, and turn insights into optimization opportunities. Your Skills You bring at least 5 years of experience in client management, sales, or consulting at a social media or digital agency, including strategic client leadership. You combine strong business acumen with a love for numbers, building calculations and reports that balance client needs with agency profitability. You live social media, follow platform trends closely, and use AI tools every day to work smarter across research, reporting, and pitch preparation. You navigate complex stakeholder environments with confidence and bring excellent communication and negotiation skills in both Italian and English. You challenge norms, stay hands-on, compete to win, and always protect your team, because belonging matters to you as much as results. We are thought leaders in our space, and believe in sharing that journey with other people who are ambitious and think big! We work closely with merchants, creators, and partners to support sustainable business growth while keeping the experience safe and trusted for the community. As the business scales across global markets, we take on complex challenges across content, commerce, trust, and the differing needs of each local market. You will help shape the future of AI-native commerce, where discovery, entertainment, and buying happen in the same place. This role is based in our Milan office. Responsibilities: - Define the long-term vision and strategic roadmap for your category, setting direction and leading key cross-functional initiatives. - Own the full P&L responsibility for your category, driving both topline and profitability. - Leverage industry knowledge and your professional network to fuel category growth and success. - Build and lead a high-performing team—hiring, developing, and coaching top talent. - Identify, prioritize, and onboard new sellers, actively shaping the category's ecosystem on TikTok Shop. - Drive end-to-end seller development by managing strategic relationships and optimizing their performance. - Collaborate with internal teams—including operations, product, and marketing—to unlock seller potential and accelerate adoption of livestream and short video commerce. - Operate effectively in a dynamic environment, navigating ambiguity, adapting to change, and influencing key stakeholders to enable strategic decisions. - Break down complex problems, identify innovative approaches, and implement scalable solutions to drive long-term success. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications: - Proven experience leading and scaling high-performing teams. - Strong strategic mindset with the ability to execute with precision and operational excellence. - Demonstrated ability to use data-driven insights to inform decisions and optimize performance. - Extensive experience in category management with a track record of delivering ambitious results. - Deep understanding of the Italian market, including consumer behavior, digital trends, and mobile commerce transformation. - Growth-oriented, entrepreneurial mindset with excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. - Fluent in both Italian and English, ensuring seamless communication with local partners and stakeholders. Preferred Qualifications: - Strong understanding of E-commerce, content marketing and influencers - Experience of owning P&L on an E-commerce platform/marketplace - Experience in managing diverse teams - Ability to thrive in ambiguity and adjust quickly to change About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.​ ​ Diversity & Inclusion​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.​ Job Information 【For Pay Transparency】 Italy Compensation Description (Annual) - TikTok The initial gross annual salary for this position in the selected city is EUR 82800, paid pursuant to and inclusive of any relevant provisions of law and the National Collective Labour Agreement for employees of the Commercial Sector negotiated by Confcommercio.​ Compensation may vary depending on a number of factors, including a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies and experience, and location. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.​ In line with our company philosophy and commitment to equal treatment, our Total Rewards package is designed to ensure fairness, transparency, and employee wellbeing. The benefits offered are competitive within the local market, aligned with statutory requirements and best practices, and may vary depending on the nature of employment. Learn more about our benefits at https://lifeattiktok.com/culture.​ These benefits are extended to all employees in a fair and transparent manner, in accordance with legal and regulatory requirements. Business Manager - Marché Italien À propos de LUCA LUCA, filiale de MEOGROUP, est une agence d’Architecture d’Intérieur et de Design global spécialisée dans l’aménagement et la rénovation d’espaces hospitality. Nous intervenons dans le cadre de projets d’Aménagement / Transformation / Création / Déploiement d’espaces Hospitality où nous portons une attention toute particulière à l’Expérience Utilisateur (Retail, Hôtelleries, Workplace, Événementiel, Restaurations). Nos Architectes et Chefs de projet prennent la responsabilité des projets de A à Z, des phases de conception jusqu’à la livraison. LUCA a pour mission de permettre à ses clients d’assurer la réalisation de leurs projets à travers le Monde dans des conditions de délais, de qualités et de coûts maitrisés. Dans le cadre de notre développement à l'international, nous souhaitons implanter LUCA sur le marché italien avec l'ouverture d'une première agence à Milan. Nous recherchons un(e) Business Manager en CDI pour prendre part à ce lancement et contribuer activement à la création et au développement de cette nouvelle implantation. Véritable moteur du développement local, vous aurez pour mission de construire progressivement l'activité de l'agence, en intervenant sur trois axes principaux : la prospection commerciale, le recrutement et le management. Vous participerez ainsi à la structuration de LUCA sur le marché italien et à la mise en place de ses premières équipes. Lieu d'intervention Milan, Italie Votre rôle Lancement et développement commercial de l'agence Participer à la création et au lancement de l'agence LUCA à Milan. Définir et mettre en œuvre une stratégie de prospection adaptée au marché italien. Identifier de nouveaux clients et développer un premier portefeuille commercial. Détecter les opportunités business et comprendre les besoins des entreprises. Construire et développer des relations commerciales durables avec les clients et partenaires locaux. Contribuer à faire connaître LUCA et à renforcer sa présence sur le marché italien. Recrutement et constitution des équipes Identifier les premiers besoins en recrutement en fonction des opportunités commerciales. Développer un vivier de candidats et piloter les recrutements de A à Z : sourcing, entretiens et sélection. Recruter les premiers consultants et accompagner leur intégration. Participer progressivement à la constitution et au développement de l'équipe locale. Management et développement de l'activité Assurer le suivi et l'accompagnement des premiers collaborateurs recrutés. Accompagner la montée en puissance de l'agence et structurer progressivement son organisation. Suivre les indicateurs de performance commerciaux et de recrutement. Participer à la définition des objectifs de développement et veiller à leur atteinte. Formation Bac +5 en école de commerce, d'ingénieur ou formation équivalente. Expérience Expérience confirmée de 5 ans minimum dans le conseil, le développement commercial ou le management d'une activité de services. Mynameis ha fornito un livello di retribuzione Questo livello è fornito da Mynameis. La tua retribuzione effettiva sarà basata sulle tue competenze e la tua esperienza. Livello retribuzione di base 120.000,00 €/yr - 150.000,00 €/anno Tipi di retribuzione aggiuntivi Bonus annuale Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Mynameis Silvia Lodovichi Silvia Lodovichi Per conto di un nostro cliente operante nel settore delle soluzioni software e digitali per l'industria manifatturiera, siamo alla ricerca di un General Manager che possa guidare la prossima fase di sviluppo e crescita dell'organizzazione. La figura avrà la responsabilità di definire e implementare le strategie di sviluppo del business, consolidare il posizionamento sul mercato e supportare l'evoluzione organizzativa dell'azienda in un contesto caratterizzato da innovazione tecnologica e forte potenziale di espansione. Principali responsabilità Definire e guidare la strategia commerciale e di sviluppo aziendale, con particolare attenzione alla crescita del fatturato e all'acquisizione di nuovi clienti. Rafforzare la presenza dell'azienda sul mercato attraverso iniziative di business development, marketing e networking. Sviluppare e consolidare relazioni con clienti strategici, partner e stakeholder di riferimento. Supportare l'espansione in nuovi mercati e l'apertura di nuove opportunità commerciali, anche a livello internazionale. Affiancare il team commerciale nella gestione delle trattative più complesse e delle opportunità a maggiore valore aggiunto. Promuovere una cultura aziendale orientata al cliente, ai risultati e al miglioramento continuo. Collaborare con le funzioni tecniche e operative per favorire una maggiore valorizzazione dell'offerta e del portafoglio prodotti. Monitorare i principali indicatori economici e di performance, garantendo un approccio imprenditoriale e orientato alla creazione di valore. Guidare e sviluppare il management team, favorendo collaborazione, responsabilizzazione e crescita professionale delle persone. Requisiti Laurea in discipline economiche, ingegneristiche o affini. Almeno 8-10 anni di esperienza in ruoli manageriali presso aziende IT tecnologiche o caratterizzate da un forte contenuto di innovazione. Solida esperienza nello sviluppo commerciale, nel business development e nella gestione delle relazioni con clienti strategici. Capacità di operare trasversalmente tra funzioni commerciali, prodotto e operations. Comprovata esperienza nella gestione di team e organizzazioni strutturate. Familiarità con modelli di business basati su software, servizi ricorrenti, digitalizzazione e innovazione tecnologica. Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese. Caratteristiche personali Forte orientamento al mercato e alle opportunità di business development. Mentalità imprenditoriale e commerciale, approccio pragmatico e orientamento ai risultati. Spiccate capacità relazionali e di leadership. Elevata sensibilità economica e capacità di individuare opportunità di crescita profittevole. Attitudine a creare consenso, motivare i team e guidare il cambiamento. Forte presenza sul territorio e disponibilità a incontrare regolarmente clienti e prospect. Cosa offre il ruolo L'opportunità di assumere un ruolo strategico all'interno di una realtà solida ed in crescita, contribuendo direttamente alle decisioni di sviluppo aziendale, all'ampliamento del mercato e alla definizione delle future linee di business. Sede di lavoro: Zona Milano Est, modalità di lavoro on-site. Disponibilità: Richiesta presenza costante sul territorio e frequente interazione con clienti attuali e potenziali Pacchetto economico: prevediamo un pacchetto fisso compreso in un range 120.000-150.000€, MBO , auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo. The Regional Vice President of Sales, South EMEA is a high-visibility, high-impact leadership role driving enterprise growth and consumption across Southern Europe (including France, Italy, Spain, and Israel). You will lead and scale a high-performing organization of sales leaders and individual contributors to accelerate adoption of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud across the region. AS AN RVP SALES, SOUTH EMEA AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL: Develop and maintain an in-depth understanding of the Snowflake AI Data Cloud, including Snowflake Cortex AI, Snowpark, and Data Sharing, to guide enterprise sales cycles, navigate complex legal negotiations, remove technical barriers, and manage executive escalations. Hire, enable, coach, and motivate a high-performing South EMEA field sales organization of leaders and individual contributors aligned with Snowflake's profile for success. Scale and develop South EMEA territories through strategic account planning, disciplined territory design, and effective account assignment across Southern European markets. Accelerate Time to Capacity Agreement by driving rigorous sales execution, including effective Proofs of Concept (POCs), champion decks, partner alignment, and Snowflake Professional Services engagement. Drive sustained customer consumption of the Snowflake platform by partnering with Customer Advisory Services, Product Management, and C-level customer executives on strategic account plans and workload expansion. Lead weekly forecast reviews and operational cadence with the Area Vice President, EMEA Sales, maintaining high forecast accuracy and pipeline hygiene across South EMEA. Build and expand an in-region partner ecosystem across Southern Europe, collaborating with Global and Regional System Integrators (GSIs/RSIs) and cloud ecosystem partners including AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, and BI/AI partners. Partner with EMEA Marketing to plan, execute, and drive executive attendance at regional Snowflake events, summits, and customer forums. OUR IDEAL RVP, SOUTH EMEA WILL HAVE: 12+ years of progressive enterprise software or cloud sales experience, including 5+ years as a second-line sales leader building and managing teams of managers and individual contributors across South EMEA (France, Italy, Spain, and/or Portugal). Proven track record of leading complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles and consistently exceeding revenue and consumption-based growth targets. Strong understanding of cloud data platforms, AI/ML, analytics, and consumption-based SaaS business models. Demonstrated ability to engage C-level executives and build long-term strategic customer partnerships across Southern European enterprise markets. Strategic mindset with strong operational rigor, accurate forecasting skills, and the ability to connect regional execution to broader EMEA business drivers. High-energy, proactive, and collaborative leadership style with a proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top sales talent. Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one major South EMEA language (French, Italian, or Spanish). BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING: Prior experience scaling a high-growth consumption-based cloud, data, or AI business across multiple Southern European countries. Established executive network across enterprise customers and System Integrator partners in France, Italy, Spain, and Portugal.
