Job Description Summary Do you want to drive the commercial strategy for an industry-leading portfolio that powers the world's energy infrastructure? GE Vernova is looking for an exceptional Bushings Sales Manager to join our Power Transmission team based in Sesto San Giovanni, Italy. Job Description GE Vernova - The Energy to Change the World With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. "GE" carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. "Ver" signals Earth's lush ecosystems, while "Nova" nods to a new era of lower-carbon energy we are helping to deliver. Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable, and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety, and quality of life. Electrification Our Electrification solutions modernize grids, enable renewable integration, and strengthen energy systems. From software to power conversion and storage, we help create smarter, more resilient energy networks. Let's Talk About The Role The Bushings Sales Manager will lead the commercial growth of our bushing portfolio for transformers, generators, and substation applications across the European market. You will act as the primary commercial lead, building deep relationships with key stakeholders and collaborating with local sales teams to drive new business. By defining market-entry strategies and leading the end-to-end sales process—from initial specification through to contract closure—you will play a vital role in delivering exceptional value to our customers and expanding our market presence. How You Will Make a Difference Driving growth by deploying strategic market-entry plans and meeting order intake and gross margin targets. Leading the "spec-in" and "spec-out" process to influence customer specifications and secure product qualification across the region. Collaborating with Account Managers and local sales teams and partner with the tendering team to develop competitive, value-added technical and commercial offers. Directing tender approval process including internal presentation of the deal to the management to get the relevant validations. Close contracts and transfer to the factory execution teams. Managing the internal risk assessment process for commercial, financial, and legal viability to ensure successful project delivery. Creating and negotiating high-impact contracts while resolving technical and commercial clarifications to ensure seamless hand-off to execution teams. Special Role Requirements Able to travel frequently throughout the European region to meet with customers and support project assignments. Skills For Success You should be a strategic and dynamic sales professional with: The ability to present complex technical solutions to diverse stakeholders with clarity and impact. The capability to plan, document, and execute large-scale commercial programs in a global environment. An understanding of the electrical transmission business, including bushings, generator, transformer, or substation equipment. An expertise in navigating tender complexities and resolving contract concerns. A keen interest in fostering cross-functional collaboration within a fast-paced environment. Professional proficiency in English (any other languages such as French, German, or Spanish would be a plus). A formal education and subsequent University degree in Engineering (Electrical or Management preferred) or a related field are nice to have but we are also interested in your total experience and professional achievements in a commercial or sales environment . Where And How You'll Work This is a permanent position based in our Sesto San Giovanni office. We have a hybrid working model which gives you flexibility to work from our offices and from home. Our Culture Every action shapes our future. That's why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve. Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy. Our technology helps generate approximately twenty-five percent of the world's electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change! We're determined to be the best place to grow We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We're committed to providing you with the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey. We also prioritize fair pay, performance-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do. Inclusion & Diversity We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone. As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to support disadvantaged groups whilst providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike. Join us at GE Vernova where results can be achieved by embracing a community of belonging. Founding Marketing Lead Founding Marketing Lead presso Flottando — Milano | LinkedIn Lavoro Vai al contenuto principale LinkedIn Founding Marketing Lead in zona Boydton, VA Espandi ricerca Questo pulsante mostra il tipo di ricerca attualmente selezionato. Lavoro Persone Learning Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Cancella testo Accedi Iscriviti ora Founding Marketing Lead Flottando Milano Candidati Founding Marketing Lead Flottando Milano 2 giorni fa 138 candidati Guarda chi è stato assunto da Flottando per questo ruolo Candidati Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro About this Job Location: Milan, Italy (Hybrid – 3 days/week in the office, 2 remote) Type: Full-time – with a clear path to Head of Marketing About Flottando Company cars are boring. We need someone crazy enough to make them exciting. 🚗 At Flottando we build AI software for corporate fleets. That means invoices, multe, fringe benefits, contract renewals and the Excel files that HR, Procurement and Finance trade back and forth every month. Hundreds of Italian companies already use us, and many of them are happy to tell their story. Now we need someone to go out and tell it, loudly. The role Let's be honest about this role. There's no marketing team waiting for you, no agency, no big budget and no brand guidelines. There's you, a laptop, a small and hungry founding team, and a product customers love. You'll write the post, film the video, book the guest, run the webinar, set up the event booth, send the follow-ups, and check on Monday whether any of it turned into pipeline. Then you'll do it again, better. If that sounds exhausting, this isn't for you. If it sounds like the best job ever, keep reading. Where this goes 🚀 You start as our first marketer. As Flottando grows in Italy and expands into Europe, you grow with it: you'll hire the team, own the budget and become our Head of Marketing. We're not hiring someone to fill a seat. We're looking for the person who will lead marketing here. What you will do • Call happy customers and turn them into case studies, videos and LinkedIn posts, starting in week one • Run our social channels yourself: writing, filming, editing, posting • Organize webinars and events from scratch, including topic, speakers, promotion, hosting and follow-up • Generate leads, hand them to sales, and track what becomes revenue • Launch our new AI products and make people understand why they matter • Do our employer branding so great people want to join us • Test, measure, kill what doesn't work and double down on what does • Challenge the founders. The CEO sets the strategy, and you push back when the data says otherwise Here's an example. In a demo, a fleet manager says she used to spend three days a month building cost reports in Excel. You hear it. You call her, record a 60-second video, turn it into a LinkedIn post, build a webinar around it, and check two weeks later how many demos it brought in. That's the mindset we're looking for. Who we are looking for You're probably a great fit if: • You're hands-on: you've done the work yourself, not just managed others doing it • You love startups: chaos, speed and building from zero excite you • You're entrepreneurial: you don't wait for a brief, a budget or permission. You ship • You're analytical: you care about leads and revenue, not likes • You're a strong communicator in writing, on camera and on stage • You're creative enough to make fleet management fun (yes, really) • You're high-energy and positive. Ogni giorno lavori sul campo: analizzi il mercato, costruisci relazioni solide, intercetti opportunità e proponi soluzioni HR a valore aggiunto, promuovendo in modo proattivo tutti i servizi del Gruppo. Allo stesso tempo, fai crescere le persone: ispiri il team, definisci obiettivi chiari e condivisi e crei un ambiente orientato alla performance, alla collaborazione e al risultato. Ti muovi in un contesto dinamico e competitivo, supportato da strumenti digitali e in costante connessione con le funzioni aziendali, con un obiettivo chiaro: generare impatto, far crescere il business e accompagnare il successo della tua filiale e dei tuoi clienti. Livello retribuzione di base 35.000,00 €/yr - 45.000,00 €/anno Importante realtà operante nel settore dei servizi e della mobilità è alla ricerca di un/a IT Project Manager - con competenze multicanale Web & Mobile da inserire all'interno dell'Area ICT & Digital. La risorsa si occuperà della gestione e dell'evoluzione dei canali aziendali (siti web e app), supportando l'implementazione di nuovi servizi e il miglioramento della customer experience. Responsabilità La risorsa sarà responsabile della gestione e dell'evoluzione dell'ecosistema aziendale, con particolare focus su piattaforme web, applicazioni mobile e servizi digitali rivolti agli utenti. In particolare si occuperà di: Gestione, monitoraggio e ottimizzazione delle piattaforme web e mobile aziendali, garantendone affidabilità, performance e continuità operativa. Raccolta e analisi dei requisiti di business, definizione delle specifiche funzionali e coordinamento degli sviluppi applicativi. Governance del ciclo di vita delle applicazioni digitali, pianificando roadmap evolutive e nuove implementazioni. Collaborazione con team IT, fornitori e stakeholder aziendali per la realizzazione di soluzioni digitali innovative. Implementazione e ottimizzazione di servizi digitali e funzionalità a supporto dell'esperienza utente. Supporto all'evoluzione dei canali digitali e delle piattaforme e-commerce, contribuendo al miglioramento della customer journey. Gestione e sviluppo di strumenti di automazione, customer engagement e digital interaction. Presidio delle tematiche di accessibilità, usabilità, sicurezza applicativa e conformità normativa. Supervisione dell'integrazione tra piattaforme, CRM, database e altri sistemi aziendali. Analisi dei dati e monitoraggio delle performance digitali attraverso KPI e dashboard dedicate. Supporto alle attività di reporting e data-driven decision making per l'ottimizzazione dei servizi digitali. Profilo Verranno prese in considerazione figure in possesso dei seguenti requisiti Laurea in discipline STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Mathematics) o percorso equivalente. Esperienza maturata in aziende operanti nei settori Trasporti, Logistica, Mobilità o Infrastrutture Esperienza nella gestione di applicazioni web e mobile in contesti strutturati. Conoscenza delle architetture digitali, dei processi e-commerce e delle principali piattaforme di Ticketing e vendita online. Conoscenza delle dinamiche legate alla mobilità. Esperienza nell'utilizzo e gestione di piattaforme CRM, database e strumenti di marketing automation. Ottima conoscenza del linguaggio SQL e dei principali strumenti di interrogazione e analisi dati. Familiarità con tematiche di integrazione applicativa, gestione dati e servizi digitali. Conoscenza delle normative GDPR, delle linee guida di accessibilità digitale e dei requisiti di compliance IT. Ottime capacità di analisi, project management e coordinamento di stakeholder interni ed esterni. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Customer Care Operations Lead is the essential link between the Global Customer Care Centre of Excellence (CoE) and your local market, you’ll own and manage instrument order fulfilment, customer enquiries, resolve escalated requests , and ensure every interaction meets both global standards and specific local needs and requirements. You will partner across commercial, service, supply chain, and customer care functions to drive customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while balancing global processes with local market needs and contribute to team training, making a meaningful impact on our customers, partners, and business every day. This is an onsite role in Buccinasco, Italy. In This Role You Will Have The Opportunity To Oversee complex instrument installations, relocations, deinstallations, backlog execution, , supplier coordination, forecasting, invoicing and regional supply chain requirements to ensure seamless customer delivery. Serve as the regional contact for customer enquiries, escalation support leveraging Voice of Customer insights, operational data, and trend analysis to resolve issues, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver successful outcomes. Partner with Sales, Service, Contracts, Tenders, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and other stakeholders to remove barriers, improve operational performance, and enhance the end-to-end customer experience. Monitor performance metrics, identify trends, implement process improvements, and balance global standards with local business requirements to improve efficiency, service delivery, and business results. Act as the Customer Care Center of Excellence (CoE) market representative, translating regional needs into global improvements while supporting business continuity, training, knowledge sharing, and process standardization across teams. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor's degree or equivalent extensive experience in customer-facing roles with a strong understanding of Customer Care processes, customer escalation management, quality practices, and continuous improvement methodologies to ensure consistent service delivery. Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex situations, apply sound judgment, and drive customer issues and escalations to timely resolution through a structured, solution-oriented approach. Proven experience coordinating across multiple functions, building strong relationships, and working effectively within a matrix organization to deliver business results and exceptional customer experiences. Ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, think critically under pressure, and adapt quickly to changing business needs while maintaining a positive and professional attitude. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence. We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go. Join EY and help to build a better working world. The Opportunity We're expanding our product ownership capability to accelerate Talent transformation and support our journey to becoming a skills-based organisation. As our Global Skills & Talent Intelligence Product Owner, you'll shape how employees discover opportunities, build skills, and develop their careers. Working at the intersection of Talent, technology, data, and AI, you'll define product strategy, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver solutions that create exceptional employee experiences and measurable business value. Your Key Responsibilities Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for Skills and Talent Intelligence products. Partner with Talent and Technology leaders to align priorities, investments, and outcomes. Drive adoption of AI-enabled capabilities that enhance workforce insights and employee experiences. Translate business and user needs into scalable, data-driven solutions. Use data, feedback, and market insights to continuously improve product performance and value. Lead prioritisation, governance, and investment decisions across a global stakeholder community. Deliver outcomes through collaboration, influence, and strong cross-functional partnerships. Support successful deployment, adoption, and value realisation of Talent technology solutions. Skills And Attributes For Success Proven product ownership experience, balancing strategic vision with execution. Strong understanding of Talent technology and the role of skills data in workforce transformation. Excellent stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills. Ability to leverage AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve Talent outcomes. Strong problem-solving skills, commercial awareness, and user-focused decision-making. Ability to navigate complexity, build alignment, and deliver results through peers in a global environment. Ideally, You'll Also Bring expertise in platforms that enable skills-based organisations. Have hands-on experience with SAP SuccessFactors, particularly Talent Intelligence Hub (TIH) and Career & Talent Development (CTD). Possess knowledge of ProFinda or similar talent marketplace and skills intelligence platforms. What we offer you At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more. EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Speichern Diesen Job melden Introduction Are you passionate about building and operating Kubernetes platforms at scale? Do you enjoy diving deep into complex technical challenges, from low-level troubleshooting to platform architecture? And are you someone who enjoys taking ownership, driving technical excellence and helping other engineers grow? If so, we are looking for you! As a hands-on Kubernetes Platform Engineer with technical leadership responsibilities, you will own the design, operation and continuous improvement of our enterprise Kubernetes platform, which supports mission-critical financial services in a PCI DSS-regulated environment. This role combines deep technical expertise with technical leadership. Whether you are tracing a production incident down to the kernel, shaping the platform architecture or mentoring fellow engineers, you will have the opportunity to make a real impact. Working closely with development, security and infrastructure teams, you will help ensure that our platform is reliable, secure and a great foundation for building software. The position is available immediately or by mutual agreement. Responsibilities Design, operate and evolve Rancher-managed RKE2 clusters: provisioning, upgrades, capacity planning, troubleshooting and lifecycle management. Automate infrastructure and application delivery with Terraform, Helm, Argo CD and GitOps practices. Engineer core platform services: networking, ingress, storage, secrets management, observability and disaster recovery. Build and improve observability with Dynatrace, Splunk, but also Prometheus, Thanos, Grafana, Loki, Tempo and OpenTelemetry. Lead the response to complex production incidents across Kubernetes, Linux and storage, with a focus on root-cause analysis and long-term fixes rather than workarounds. Provide technical leadership, architectural guidance and mentoring to colleagues. Qualifications Several years of hands-on experience running Kubernetes in production, ideally RKE2 and Rancher or a comparable enterprise distribution. Knowledge of SRE principles and strong GitOps and infrastructure-as-code skills (Terraform, Helm, Argo CD). Solid Linux, networking and storage troubleshooting skills. Practical experience with Kubernetes security and modern observability. Experience working in a regulated environment, or the willingness and discipline to work in one. Fluent English. German and Italian is a plus. Job Benefits At Viseca you will work in a dynamic and creative environment with good development opportunities. We maintain an open and uncomplicated culture and offer our employees extensive decision-making powers in addition to a thorough introduction, home office possibility, attractive employment conditions and progressive fringe benefits. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Ciao, we're TextYess 👋 We're the AI-first CRM that turns conversations into revenue. On-site, WhatsApp, email, voice: our AI Agents sell, support, and retain customers for the best B2C brands out there, autonomously. We believe the future of commerce is warmer, more human than ever - just at a scale no human team could pull off alone. We've raised €7M+ and work with brands like Ducati, Pittarosso, MC2 Saint Barth, and Doppelgänger. We're a lean, fast, Italian-born scale-up now expanding our story internationally and this role is a big part of writing it. The role We're growing from a WhatsApp marketing point solution into a full CRM, and our product already wins deals against Klaviyo, Omnisend and other big players in the space. Yet, we haven’t decided how we position it, how we stand apart or how we win. We also ship improvements every week but most of the market, including many of our own customers, never hears about them. As our first Product Marketing Manager, you'll own how TextYess is positioned, priced and launched, and give sales and customers the proof that wins and expands deals, reporting to our Head of Marketing and working closely with the founders, product and sales. What You'll Actually Be Doing Own our positioning and differentiation for the full CRM: who we're for, why we win against competitors, and what we say about it on the site, in ads, in sales decks and on every call. Run launches (big or small) for every relevant release, aimed at prospects, existing customers and sales: You decide what’s worth a launch, the story and who hears it, and how to turn it into content such as ads, posts and webinars. Build pricing and packaging for the full CRM with the founders and product, along with the pricing story sales tells. Create what sales needs to win: the deck, battlecards against Klaviyo and others, objection handling, comparison pages and a library of customer case studies. Grow the CRM within our customer base: most customers came to us for WhatsApp. Get them using email and the rest of the CRM, and turn the happiest ones into case studies, reviews and referrals. Know why brands choose us, or don’t: talk to customers, listen to won and lost deals and to brands that switched from Klaviyo, and track competitors, so our positioning is built on evidence. What You Bring A proven top performer. You stood out at a high-growth startup, or trained at MBB consulting or in investment banking, and have since done at least 2 years of B2B SaaS product marketing. Martech, CRM or ecommerce software experience is a plus. You've positioned a product against bigger players and launched to existing customers, not only prospects, and can show what changed: win rate, adoption or pipeline. Structured thinking and fast execution: you turn a messy market into a clear story, then ship it in weeks, not quarters. You start from customers: you run interviews, sit in sales calls, and build the story from what buyers tell you. Fluent Italian and English, and you write simply in both. Why TextYess Be our first PMM. You're a key marketing hire, so you'll help build the marketing function, not just join it. Own the biggest launch in our history. The full CRM goes to market in 2027, and you decide how it's positioned, priced and launched. A winning story nobody has told yet. Our product already wins deals against Klaviyo. Your job is to make the market hear it. Work directly with the founders, product and sales. No layers between your work and the decisions it shapes. Grow as fast as you push. Your scope grows with what you prove you can do, and as we scale this role can grow into leading marketing. What we offer: Salary: The gross annual salary (RAL) ranges from €45000 to €65000 depending on relevant experience and fit with the role. Stock Options: You'll receive a highly incentivizing stock options package so that if TextYess becomes a giant company, you can enjoy substantial rewards. We want to make TextYess feel like yours too. Infinite growth and responsibility: We are still at the beginning of our journey, and the challenges we will face in the coming years are numerous and highly demanding. Your work will be crucial to the success or failure of TextYess! Our hiring process We keep it real and reasonably fast: Screening call, let's just talk. Communication, fit, the basics. Technical Interview with the Hiring Manager for this role Interview + live case study, a conversation about the positioning and launches you've owned, followed by a short case study (2 hours max) built from real customer calls and release notes. Founder & Team conversations, here you meet the people you'd actually work with. Debrief, reference check, and decision. We move quickly once we're there. Sound like you? If you want to own something real from day one and help write TextYess’ growth story, we want to meet you! TextYess is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences. Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description Summary The Molecular Imaging (MI) Modality Manager is accountable to grow orders, revenue and margins for GEHC MI products lines within the IMI geographical area (Italy, Israel and Malta). He/She drives a coherent product differentiation for the assigned product range and optimizes the use of resources in conjunction with Zone Manager and Enterprise Sales team to cover market potential for his/her segment, to achieve the Operating plan. The Modality Manager has direct management of the Product Sales Specialists (PSS) Job Description Roles and Responsibilities Financial Performance & Sales Management Is accountable to achieve the quarterly and yearly Operating Plan targets (Orders, Sales, Contribution Margin, and Cash, where applicable) for Italy, Israel and Malta. Is accountable for timely and accurate forecasting of Orders and S&I and is responsible for driving optimal Imaging Operating Mechanisms (IOMs) to monitor and track progress of opportunities and deliver on Order commitment. Is responsible to ensure that all PSS utilize the required sales tool (CRM) to create pipeline visibility and assist accurate forecasting (SFDC rigor). Provide input to and contribute to the formulation of the yearly business planning cycles for the MI Business within IMI (e.g. Marketing plan, BPR session). Is responsible to set appropriate OP targets for PSS Customers, Market & Product expertise Continuously develop deep clinical and technical knowledge of products, including awareness of current and future trends in MI healthcare technology and healthcare funding mechanisms. Understand and analyze market dynamics and competition to set business strategies and develop opportunities (i.e., protect IB); provide ongoing feedback to management (Region and marketing). Drive product’s configuration quality at the point of offer and order entry to ensure accuracy, configuration integrity and that all requirements are tied to documented customer inputs. Lead, educate and drive products positioning & strategy (value proposition and key messages) of MI product/solution/service through adeguate products training sessions to sales teams (PSS & AM). Coach and assist the PSS/PCS with the differentiation of product offerings during the various stages of the sales process; ensure that all PSS/PCS have clear opportunity management activity and call plans to ensure efficient coverage of decision makers and influencers Maintain professional relations with KOLs and customers in Academia, and nurture relationships with professional society stakeholders, to ensure understanding of needs and positioning new products (NPIs) in these key customer groups. Team Coaching Drive a culture of Simplification, Fastwork and Digital adoption among the team members, encouraging and facilitating the collaboration across horizontal teams (Service, ITO, OTR, Finance, Design team, etc.). Drive employee engagement activities to ensure retention, recognizing success, sharing best practices, providing exposure to senior leaders within the Region and Headquarters. Drives performance management within the team, providing a regular mechanism of feedbacks. Regularly provides updates to team on company, region product strategies and customer insights. Act as a role model for collaborative mindset across functions, facilitate effective communication & trustful collaboration within the Zone/Product matrix organization.. Required Qualifications Grounded, solid experience in healthcare industry with track record in Sales functions. Solid experience in people management, leadership skills, as well as sales coaching & team building skills. Strong business acumen and data interpretation; negotiation and financial skills. Strong leadership capabilities, including strategic planning and execution, influencing skills. High level presentation and interpersonal skills; able to communicate and present ideas to customers in a way that produces understanding and impact that builds effective strategic relationships. Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport, collaboration and influence at all levels within an organization. Act as inspirational leader with optimism, highly approachable and humble. Ability to operate effectively in a multi-tasking, dynamic environment, while maintaining a forward-thinking and customer-first attitude. Excellent oral and written communications skills in English and Italian Excellent time management skills with the ability to manage multiple details and deadlines. Education to Bachelor/Master Degree level (preferred). For this application we also evaluate candidates who meet the requirements set out in the art. 1 or belonging to the protected categories referred to in art. 18 of law 68/99 Inclusion and Diversity GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law. Behaviors We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity. Total Rewards Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration and support. Salva Segnala offerta di lavoro Job Description La risorsa verrà inserita all'interno dell' Ufficio Marketing e, operando in costante sinergia con il team interno, l' R&D e i fornitori, si occuperà della gestione e del ciclo di vita dei prodotti, dal concept iniziale fino al monitoraggio sul mercato. Principali Responsabilità Sviluppo e lancio di nuovi prodotti (NPD) in stretta collaborazione con il reparto R&D e i fornitori. Gestione del posizionamento di mercato e strategia di valorizzazione dei brand aziendali. Analisi della concorrenza (benchmarking) e conduzione di ricerche sul consumatore finale e trend di settore. Pianificazione e implementazione delle attività di comunicazione e delle strategie di promozione nei punti vendita (trade marketing / canale farmacia ed erboristeria). Formazione tecnica della rete di vendita in merito ai prodotti già presenti in portfolio e alle novità di canale. Requirements Requisiti : Laurea in ambito scientifico (Biotecnologie, Chimica e Tecnologia Farmaceutiche - CTF, Farmacia, Scienze e Tecnologie Alimentari o affini) con competenze o solido interesse per il marketing di prodotto. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2 anni maturata come Product Manager o figure analoghe presso aziende di produzione o commercializzazione di integratori alimentari, nutraceutici o cosmesi naturale. Ottima padronanza della lingua inglese. Spiccata attitudine al problem solving, flessibilità operativa e ottima predisposizione al lavoro in team. Inquadramento Contratto: Inserimento diretto a tempo determinato per sostituzione maternità. Settore: Nutraceutico / Chimico-Farmaceutico (Integratori Alimentari). Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology? At Leica Biosystems, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact. You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life. At Leica Biosystems, we’re not just shaping the future of cancer diagnostics — we’re transforming lives. Our mission of “Advancing Cancer Diagnostics, Improving Lives” is the driving force behind everything we do. As a global leader with the most comprehensive portfolio spanning from biopsy to diagnosis, we empower clinicians with innovative, reliable solutions so they can give patients timely, accurate answers when they need them most. When you join Leica Biosystems, you’re not just taking a job; you’re becoming part of a passionate team that knows every moment matters when it comes to cancer. You’ll help develop diagnostic solutions that turn anxiety into answers, and aid the acceleration of next-generation, life-changing therapies. Surrounded by a diverse and collaborative global community, you’ll be inspired each day to stretch, grow, and make an impact. Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible. The Customer Care Operations Lead is the essential link between the Global Customer Care Centre of Excellence (CoE) and your local market, you’ll own and manage instrument order fulfilment, customer enquiries, resolve escalated requests , and ensure every interaction meets both global standards and specific local needs and requirements. You will partner across commercial, service, supply chain, and customer care functions to drive customer satisfaction, operational excellence, and continuous improvement while balancing global processes with local market needs and contribute to team training, making a meaningful impact on our customers, partners, and business every day. This is an onsite role in Buccinasco, Italy. In This Role You Will Have The Opportunity To Oversee complex instrument installations, relocations, deinstallations, backlog execution, , supplier coordination, forecasting, invoicing and regional supply chain requirements to ensure seamless customer delivery. Serve as the regional contact for customer enquiries, escalation support leveraging Voice of Customer insights, operational data, and trend analysis to resolve issues, improve customer satisfaction, and deliver successful outcomes. Partner with Sales, Service, Contracts, Tenders, Supply Chain, Logistics, Finance, and other stakeholders to remove barriers, improve operational performance, and enhance the end-to-end customer experience. Monitor performance metrics, identify trends, implement process improvements, and balance global standards with local business requirements to improve efficiency, service delivery, and business results. Act as the Customer Care Center of Excellence (CoE) market representative, translating regional needs into global improvements while supporting business continuity, training, knowledge sharing, and process standardization across teams. The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include Bachelor's degree or equivalent extensive experience in customer-facing roles with a strong understanding of Customer Care processes, customer escalation management, quality practices, and continuous improvement methodologies to ensure consistent service delivery. Demonstrated ability to independently assess complex situations, apply sound judgment, and drive customer issues and escalations to timely resolution through a structured, solution-oriented approach. Proven experience coordinating across multiple functions, building strong relationships, and working effectively within a matrix organization to deliver business results and exceptional customer experiences. Ability to work autonomously, prioritize competing demands, think critically under pressure, and adapt quickly to changing business needs while maintaining a positive and professional attitude.
